settings.heading:
Clay that
doesn't cost the earth
settings.text: Good ceramics start before the wheel — at the quarry, the glaze lab, and the packing table. We choose materials and partners that let us make beautiful things without passing the costs on to people or the planet.

settings.heading:
Local reserves,
etically managed
settings.text: All of our clay comes from nearby mineral reserves with responsible extraction practices. Our glazes are mixed in-house from lead-free, food-safe components, and every batch is fired to food-safe certification standards.
settings.quote: If a material can't be traced back to a source we're proud of, it doesn't go in the kiln.

settings.title: Local clay
settings.text: Clay sourced from nearby, responsibly managed mineral reserves.

settings.title: Lead-free glazes
settings.text: Food-safe, lead-free glazes mixed in-house to certification standards.

settings.title: Ethical labor
settings.text: Fair living wages for every apprentice and studio workshop member.

settings.title: Plastic-free packing
